tutorials.description: A guide to playing WarioWare, Inc. - Mega Microgame$! with Archipelago

notes.text:
a few extra (free) locations, some fixes and ut additions thanks to wario twisted
# Info
* [Info](https://thelx5.github.io/wario_ware_inc/index.html)
* [Setup](https://thelx5.github.io/wario_ware_inc/setup.html)
## Changes
* Adds new point locations for character stages to aid with generation success rate
  * Those are below the Clear point rank, so they're basically free to get alongside the Clear location
* Removes starting microgames from the pool when unlocking them separately
* No longer excludes some microgames at random when playing with individual level unlocks and more than 113 microgames in the pool
* Adjusted some text in the game
* [Universal Tracker] The tracker tab will now tell players which character holds the microgame as an alias
* [Universal Tracker] Microgames now show in their alias string how many points are required to get a flower rank
